title: apera spica-venti subsp. intermedia
intro: Apera spica-venti subsp. intermedia, commonly known as the lesser meadow-grass, is a perennial grass species. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as wound healing, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic effects. The therapeutic actions of this plant include soothing and protecting the skin, reducing pain and inflammation, and promoting tissue repair, attributed to its bioactive constituents like flavonoids and phenolic acids.
